kamloops.title: Cultural programs for urban Indigenous girls can help address MMIWG crisis, advocates say
kamloops.description: Advocates say cultural programming can help young Indigenous girls to build strong relationships, leadership skills and a sense of belonging, so they feel valued and seen.

all.title: Regulator suspends B.C. Realtor's licence, cites 'urgent circumstances'
all.description: British Columbia's superintendent of real estate has suspended the licence of a Metro Vancouver Realtor and her personal real estate corporation.
